# Kalpasūtra — working notes (pilot, 2026-11-21)

- Edition: Jacobi 1879 (Wellcome Collection scan b30094483, Public Domain Mark); text pages begin at PDF p. 49 (printed p. 33).
- Display follows the Gita: Devanagari text, word-by-word readings, glossary embedded in each part. The reading line is Jacobi's own
  romanization in IAST, which already separates compound members; the Devanagari is generated from it.
- Jacobi's sigla used in notes: A, B, C (his own MSS), E (Berlin), H (India Office), M (Bombay). Round brackets = not in A;
  square brackets = not in A and C. His variant footnotes are not reproduced.
- Dotted ọ in the print marks an o produced by vowel contraction; written o.
- Open for Zev: Prakrit voice (Kannada voice as for Sanskrit is the obvious first sample); whether to show Jacobi's Roman letters
  as the main text instead of Devanagari.
- Next parts: §5 onward (Devānandā tells Ṛṣabhadatta her dreams) — page images PDF p. 50 ff.
